page.overview:
What is Annihilation?

The Annihilation, known in Mando'a as Dral'Han, was a battle in the final war of the larger, ancient Mandalorian conflict, between the Jedi uninhabitable outside of hermetically sealed dome cities.

The centuries of war that consumed Mandalore also helped destroy its landscape. were destroyed during the wars she lived to see.

The concept of a cataclysm devastating Mandalore was created as part of the backstory of the Mandalorian people as depicted in the Star Wars: The Clone Wars animated series. though this information is no longer considered canon.

Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two
